item.title: Virginia Passes Law Requiring Educators To Teach The Truth About Jan 6th
item.description: Virginia lawmakers have passed a bill that prohibits schools from teaching that the January 6, 2021, Capitol riot was a peaceful protest or that there was widespread election fraud. Instead, the law requires that the event be described as a violent attack on U.S. democratic institutions.
